answer: A cross-chain bridge can stop Sybil farms by requiring every agent to lock an individual, non-refundable hardware bond inside an escrow oasis before submitting state claims. Auditors sample random traffic with a yarrow-seeded verifiable beacon; any duplicated or spoofed claim slashes the entire bond. An attacker trying to run 500 fake agents must purchase 500 physical security chips and lock 500 separate bonds at 0 each, losing 0,000 immediately upon audit.
